FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Massachusetts fishing licence

Freshwater anglers aged 15 or older need a licence. Saltwater uses a separate permit from age 16, and seniors must obtain it even when it is free.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Freshwater anglers aged 15 or older.
  • Saltwater anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Freshwater anglers under 15.
  • Saltwater anglers under 16.
  • Saltwater anglers on permitted for-hire vessels.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident freshwater 3-daynon resident3 days$30.50 USD
Non-resident freshwater annualnon residentCalendar year$50 USD
Recreational saltwater permitanyThrough December 31$10 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Wildlands Conservation Stamp · $5 USD
    Added to all non-resident freshwater licences.

Saltwater

The marine permit costs the same for residents and visitors. Anglers aged 60 or older must obtain a free permit.

Fishing with a guide or charter

A permitted saltwater charter or head boat exempts its clients from the individual marine permit.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the current saltwater permit in paper or digital form.
  • Freshwater fees exclude the conservation stamp; online transaction fees can also apply.

How to buy

Use MassFishHunt online or a licence sales location.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Massachusetts?

Freshwater anglers aged 15 or older need a licence. Saltwater uses a separate permit from age 16, and seniors must obtain it even when it is free.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Massachusetts?

Non-resident freshwater 3-day: $30.50 USD; Non-resident freshwater annual: $50 USD; Recreational saltwater permit: $10 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Massachusetts?

Use MassFishHunt online or a licence sales location.
